M001.text: Hi Robert, I've submitted your refill request for Lisinopril to Dr. Okafor for approval. Thanks!

M002.text: Hi Priya, I've successfully moved your follow-up appointment with Sarah Kim, NP from Wednesday, November 11 at 10:00 AM to Friday, November 13 at 1:00 PM. Let us know if you need anything else!

M003.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M004.text: Hello Thomas, thank you for your refill request for metformin. Because you haven't been seen by Dr. Okafor in the past 12 months, our policy requires an appointment before we can refill this medication. Your supply runs out on November 11, so we've routed your request to Dr. Okafor's team urgently. We have availability today, November 9, starting at 9:00 AM or 10:20 AM with Dr. Okafor. Please let us know if you would like to book one of these times or call the clinic.

M005.text: Hi Marcus, because Xanax is a controlled substance, your refill request cannot be processed automatically and has been routed to your provider, Dr. Okafor, for review.

M006.text: Hi Emily, I've queued your sertraline refill request for Dr. Patel's review. Because you mentioned feeling really low, I've also forwarded your message to our clinical team for prompt attention today.

M007.text: Hi Jessica, yes, Maplewood Family Clinic is currently accepting new patients! We would be happy to schedule your physical. We have several openings available, such as today, November 9, at 9:00 AM with Sarah Kim, NP. Please let us know if you would like to book this time or if another day works better for you.

M008.text: Hi Daniel, I have forwarded your inquiry about your balance and the $240 bill to our billing team. Someone from billing will review your account and follow up with you soon.

M009.text: Hi William, I've queued your levothyroxine 75 mcg refill request for Dr. Okafor's review. Note that this queues the request for approval and is not a guarantee of immediate prescription issuance.

M010.text: Hi Grace, I have booked your follow-up appointment with Dr. Patel for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 9:00 AM. Please let us know if you need to make any changes.

M011.text: Hello Mr. Chen, for your privacy and security, we cannot release lab results or health information without identity verification. Please confirm your full date of birth or contact us from the email or phone number on file so we can assist you with your records request.

M012.text: Hi Kevin, we've received your request for a zolpidem refill and have routed it to Dr. Okafor's team for review.

M013.text: Hi Fatima, your refill request for omeprazole is currently too early. Your supply runs out on November 24, and we can prepare your refill starting November 17, 2026.

M014.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M015.text: Hi Anna, I have booked a sick visit for Sofia with Sarah Kim, NP for today, Monday, November 9 at 9:00 AM. Please let us know if you need any changes.

M016.text: Hola Carlos, he agendado su cita para el chequeo anual con la Dra. Maya Patel para el lunes 16 de noviembre de 2026 a las 10:20 a.m. Si necesita hacer algún cambio, por favor avísenos. ¡Que tenga un buen día!

M017.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M018.text: Hello Ahmed, we have received your refill request for your Insulin glargine and submitted it to Dr. Okaor for review. Please note that prescriptions require provider approval before they can be filled.

M019.text: Hi Rachel, I have received your request for an oxycodone refill and noted your comment about ongoing post-surgical pain. Because this is a controlled medication, I have forwarded your request directly to Dr. Patel for review. Our team will follow up with you soon.

M020.text: Hola Linda, hemos recibido su solicitud de recarga para Metformin y la hemos enviado a su médico para su aprobación. Le notificaremos cuando esté lista.

M021.text: Hello George, we've received your request for an Amlodipine refill. Because you have no refills remaining, we have routed your request to your provider for review and renewal.

M022.text: Hi Hannah, you have two appointments scheduled for tomorrow: an 11:00 AM follow-up with Sarah Kim, NP, and a 3:00 PM telehealth visit with Dr. James Okafor. Could you please let us know which one you would like to cancel?

M023.text: Hi Olivia, the clinic will be closed on Friday, November 27 (the day after Thanksgiving). We will reopen on Monday, November 30 at 9:00 AM.

M024.text: Hi Lucy, I've booked your annual physical with Sarah Kim for today, Monday, Nov 9 at 9:20 AM. Safe travels on your trip!

M025.text: Hi Brian, I've queued your Atorvastatin refill request for Dr. Patel's review. Regarding your question about telehealth copays, I've forwarded your inquiry to our billing team, and they will follow up with you shortly.

M026.text: Hi Jonathan, because you haven't been seen in the clinic for over 12 months, an appointment is required before refilling your escitalopram. We have an opening today at 10:00 AM with your primary provider, Sarah Kim, NP. Your request has also been routed to our provider team urgently. Please let us know if you would like to book this appointment or call us to reschedule.

M027.text: Hello Mike, for privacy reasons we cannot confirm or disclose patient appointments or records to third parties. If you are an authorised caregiver, please contact our front desk or have the patient reach out to us directly.

M028.text: Hi Nora, Dr. Okafor is on leave from November 16 to November 20, so we cannot schedule your follow-up for Wednesday the 18th. We can book you with Dr. Okafor on Monday, November 23 at 9:20 AM, or with Dr. Patel or Sarah Kim on Wednesday the 18th. Please let us know your preference!

M029.text: Hi Robert, Dr. Okafor is already booked at 2:00 PM this Thursday, November 12. We have openings with him earlier at 1:40 PM or later at 2:20 PM that afternoon. Would either of those alternative times work for you?

M030.text: Hi Olivia, I've forwarded your question about your lab results to your care team. A clinician will review it and get back to you soon.

M031.text: You're very welcome, Priya! Please feel free to reach out if you need anything else.

M032.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M033.text: Hi William, we have received your request to update your phone number to 555-0199 and have routed it to our front desk team to update your records.

M034.text: Hi Fatima, I have successfully moved your annual physical to Monday, November 23, 2026, at 9:00 AM with Dr. Maya Patel.

M035.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M036.text: We are unable to process requests or share patient information without authorisation on file. To update authorised caregivers, please contact our front desk.

M037.text: Hi Lucy, our clinic is open Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with a lunch break from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM. Let us know if you need anything else!

M039.text: Hi Kevin, we have an opening for a sick visit today at 11:00 AM with Dr. Okafor. Please let us know if you would like us to book this for you.

M040.text: Hi Anna, I've forwarded your request for Sofia's vaccination record to our front desk team, and they will be in touch regarding the records.
